purpose: Prospectively test whether the recalibrated target-reader AI-smell discriminator can predict which of two independently generated neutral prose samples the actual target reader will judge less AI-like. This phase does not test a generation repair protocol.
post_generation_method: Freeze both raw outputs before evaluation.
Use the Phase379 discriminator only after both outputs are frozen.
Seal one directional prediction: which frozen output should feel less AI-like to the target reader.
Blind A/B mapping deterministically after freeze.
Actual target reader judges AI smell separately from overall preference, desire to continue, clarity/flow and skim/stop.
Reveal prediction and mappings only after human verdict.
Settle this one-pair campaign under the bounded-exit addendum; do not automatically launch another calibration pair.

acceptance.primary_measure: directional agreement on lower AI smell

next_required_action: Prepare the bounded 2000–3000 Chinese-character scene contract from the existing delivery followup draft and verified Phase370 prose/facts. No further Phase380 calibration; writing requires a scoped native task contract, with at most one initial draft and one human-located repair.
